response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack engineering experience, demonstrable leadership in AI-agent infrastructure, and deep exposure to cloud tools and agentic workflows — aligning well with core requirements. However, his resume lacks explicit evidence of 8+ years building production-grade AI solutions, direct experience with vector databases or RAG architectures, and clear metrics around AI system deployment, which are critical for a staff-level GenAI role.
strengths: Proven experience in AI-agent infrastructure and MCP frameworks at re:cinq
Extensive cloud and distributed systems experience (AWS, Kubernetes, microservices)
Strong technical leadership and mentoring track record via workshops and open-source projects
concerns: No clear evidence of 8+ years focused on production-grade AI solutions
Missing explicit experience with vector databases or RAG architectures
Limited documentation of LLM optimization, evaluation pipelines, or enterprise AI deployment metrics
